objs.name: document
objs.description: A policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other managed document subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document describing locally defined or business process-related regulations and instructions

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons within a framework

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document detailing special work steps and sub-processes with associated forms and checklists

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to an existing document created without affecting the document's version history

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who performs roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, translator or reader in the document management system

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to perform specific roles or receive document distributions

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or user-created request to extend the validity period of a document

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore an archived document

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process-supported sequence of approval steps for document release, translation, validity extension or override

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature applied by workflow participants to document their approval or action

objs.name: version
objs.description: A distinct iteration of a document with unique status, metadata and content

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups designated to receive documents and associated notifications

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach and initialize a new document object in the system with a document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the actual content of a document using the editing client

evts.name: maintain_document_metadata
evts.description: Define or update standardized and customer-specific properties and attributes of a document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read or write permissions to users or user groups for a document

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Designate specific users to participate in document release, review or approval workflow steps

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose an amendment to an existing released document without creating a new version

evts.name: submit_document_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process by submitting a document for review

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document to make it visible to designated readers

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature during workflow participation to document approval or action

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically make a released document visible to readers in the system

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid and revoke all authorizations except for the archive group

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm that a document remains valid and update its validity period

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate and restore an archived document with a new version

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check and approve a translated version of a document

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated version of a document

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and user groups of a new document version release via email

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Send workflow-supported acknowledgement requests to designated users upon document release

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document by a designated recipient
